changes.text: <:sneaky_gloves:1551904966975688825> Sneaky Gloves now have 3 uses, and only add 10% to the steal chance.
Stock for items no longer is set for daily, but weekly.
Seasons reset on the 1st of every month. Your score is the beans you earn, not your balance, so spending in the shop never hurts your rank.
The top 5 players win a bean bonus when the season ends, paid straight into their balance.
/season shows standings and time left. /seasonhistory shows past winners.
